summary: All six acceptance criteria passed on static code inspection and confirmed via live import checks. The InternVL2Backend class is correctly implemented as a VLMBackend subclass using AutoModel+AutoTokenizer with bfloat16 and a torchvision 448x448 BICUBIC transform pipeline; it does not use AutoProcessor and has no decode step, matching spec exactly. The recorder dispatch correctly gates on _is_internvl2_model_id() inside the _SDK_AVAILABLE try block, self._backend is properly widened to Optional[VLMBackend], and _short_model_label() places InternVL2 checks before the generic '2B' substring check to prevent misrouting. AVAILABLE_MODELS has all four entries in the correct order. The design review returned 'approved_with_notes' with a single minor pre-existing violation (D-1: raw font tuple in _on_error() at app.py line 295) — this is non-blocking and was not introduced by this spec. QA was bypassed by design (design-first methodology). No blockers of any severity were found. This change is merge-ready.

follow_up_notes.description: Pre-existing raw font tuple ('Segoe UI', 12) on error label in _on_error() at app.py line 295. Should be replaced with FONTS['body'] in a future cleanup task. Not a blocker for this merge.
